reports.title: Statistical Centre of Iran (SCI) institutional core
reports.description: Primary national statistical office responsible for censuses, surveys, national accounts, prices, labour, demographic and multi-domain socio-economic statistics.
reports._notes: Foundational institutional node for the Iranian statistical system.
reports._cadence_evidence: amar.org.ir homepage retrieved (most attempts time out). It shows only a dated news item (29 Tir 1397) and a reference to the 1395 Population and Housing Census; no release calendar and no stated periodicity for the office's outputs.

reports.title: Population census and estimates
reports.description: Official population census and subsequent estimates. Population is in the high-80s to low-90s millions range in recent reports; urbanisation is advanced and the age structure is shifting toward aging.
reports._notes: Core demographic node. Population ~87–93 million depending on source and reference year.
reports._cadence_evidence: Same amar.org.ir homepage. It names the 'General Population and Housing Census 1395' but states no census interval and gives no cadence for population estimates; a single census year is not countable evidence.

reports.title: National Accounts of Iran (GDP)
reports.description: Official national accounts (GDP by industry and expenditure). Central macro-output series for an oil-and-gas-influenced, sanctions-affected economy.
reports._notes: Primary macroeconomic output node.
reports._url_evidence: CBI page titled 'Annual National Accounts' (حساب‌های ملی سالانه) describing GDP time series at current and constant prices with base years 1383/1390/1395.
reports._cadence_evidence: cbi.ir/simplelist/2054.aspx (CBI National Accounts collection) states it publishes 'ارقام حسابهای ملی سالانه و فصلی' - annual and quarterly national accounts figures - with base-year revisions (latest 1395). Quarterly is the highest cadence the page states, so 4 releases/yr for the series; the annual volume is a subset of that.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
reports.description: Monthly CPI and inflation rates. Iran has experienced prolonged high inflation; the CPI series is a critical high-frequency price and welfare signal.
reports._notes: Core high-frequency price node. High inflation environment gives this series elevated centrality.

reports.title: Central Bank of the Islamic Republic of Iran institutional and reporting core
reports.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, foreign-exchange management, banking supervision and key macro-financial and external statistics. Publishes monetary, banking, exchange-rate and related series.
reports._notes: Central-bank institutional counterpart to SCI.
reports._cadence_evidence: cbi.ir root timed out repeatedly; the English landing page that did answer lists Economic Trends, Annual Review, Economic Report & Balance Sheet and 'Monetary, Financial and Economic Statistics' but states no frequency for any of them except the implied yearly Annual Review, and gives no release calendar for the institution as a whole.

reports.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
reports.description: BOP and external-sector statistics. Strongly influenced by oil and gas exports, sanctions regimes, and non-oil export performance.
reports._notes: External-accounts node with oil-dominated signature.
reports._url_evidence: CBI 'بخش تراز پرداخت‌ها' section; page states it contains balance of payments tables, customs exports/imports, external debt and monthly average dollar rates, with monthly PDFs.
reports._cadence_evidence: cbi.ir/category/2693.aspx lists successive Persian-calendar monthly PDF editions (Farvardin, Ordibehesht, Khordad, Tir) of the balance-of-payments / customs trade / external debt tables - one edition per month.

reports.title: Youth unemployment and youth labour-force statistics
reports.description: Youth (15–24) unemployment and labour-force participation statistics. Youth unemployment remains structurally elevated relative to overall rates and is a persistent social and economic pressure point.
reports._notes: Youth densification of the labour cluster.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved PDF: Statistical Centre of Iran, 'Summary of Labour Force Survey results, Autumn 1398', issued by the Office of Population, Labour Force and Census Statistics. Contains the youth series explicitly: unemployment rate for the 15-24 age group 25.8% (down 1.2 pp y/y), 18-35 age group 17.9%, overall unemployment 10.6%, participation rate 44.3%.
reports._url_route: retry of amar.org.ir after repeated failures; direct /Portals/ document path (host answered on roughly the 5th attempt)
reports._cadence_evidence: The SCI PDF (Labour Force Survey summary results, Autumn 1398) states the survey has been run 'در ماه میانی هر فصل' - in the middle month of each season - since 1384, i.e. four seasonal rounds and four result releases per year.

reports.title: Crude oil and condensate production statistics
reports.description: Official and industry statistics on crude oil and condensate production. Iran ranks among the largest OPEC producers and holds some of the world’s largest proved reserves. Production and export volumes are heavily conditioned by sanctions regimes.
reports._notes: Core hydrocarbon production node. Highest-centrality commodity uniqueness for Iran.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin site (59th edition), OPEC's official oil-data compilation covering member-country production; note it is the global ASB series page, not an Iran-specific page - OPEC country pages return HTTP 402 and mop.ir/nioc.ir are unreachable.
reports._cadence_evidence: asb.opec.org identifies itself as the OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin, 59th edition, appearing yearly since 1965 - one edition per year.

reports.title: Oil and petroleum product export statistics
reports.publisher: CBI / Ministry of Petroleum / shipping trackers
reports.description: Export volumes and estimated values for crude and petroleum products. Export levels fluctuate sharply with sanctions enforcement, buyer willingness (notably China), and shipping constraints. Strait of Hormuz remains the primary route.
reports._notes: Export-side densification of the oil cluster. Critical for external and fiscal balances.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved OPEC's Iran member-country facts-and-figures page. Shows Iran-specific 'Crude oil exports (1,000 b/d) 1,215', refinery capacity 1,715 kb/cd, refined output 1,918.4 kb/d, gas exports 9,307 mn cu m; footer states 'Source: Annual Statistical Bulletin 2014'. OPEC is a multilateral publisher. Note: the figures are dated (2014 ASB vintage); no Iranian government oil-export page could be retrieved — mop.ir and NIOC never answered.
reports._url_route: multilateral fallback (OPEC) after Ministry of Petroleum / NIOC remained unreachable
reports._cadence_evidence: opec.org/opec_web/en/about_us/163.htm is a static OPEC member-country facts-and-figures profile for Iran; it cites the Annual Statistical Bulletin as its data source but states no release frequency of its own and lists no dated editions.

reports.title: Natural gas production and domestic consumption statistics
reports.description: Statistics on dry natural gas production and domestic use. Iran is among the world’s largest gas producers (South Pars field central); most output is absorbed domestically rather than exported as LNG.
reports._notes: Gas densification of the hydrocarbon cluster.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved (twice, consistently) the Gas Exporting Countries Forum member page for Iran. Gives both series the node needs: 'Marketed production of natural gas (billion cu. m.) 199.3 (2013)' and 'Domestic Dry Natural gas consumption (incl. flared, shrinkage, gas to GTL plants, plant own use, losses and market production) (billion cu. m.) 199.292 (2013)'. GECF is a multilateral organisation of which Iran is a founding member. Figures are 2013 vintage.
reports._url_route: multilateral fallback (GECF) after mop.ir and nigc.ir stayed unreachable
reports._cadence_evidence: gecf.org/countries/iran is a static GECF member country profile; no update cadence, no release calendar and no dated editions are stated (figures shown are a snapshot).

reports.title: Labour force and unemployment statistics
reports.description: Labour-force participation, employment and unemployment rates from household surveys. Youth and female labour-market outcomes are structurally important.
reports._notes: Primary labour-market statistical product.
reports._cadence_evidence: The node points at the amar.org.ir homepage, which discusses employment/unemployment measurement concepts but states no survey or publication frequency and shows no release calendar for the labour force series.

reports.title: State budget revenue and expenditure statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Economic Affairs and Finance
reports.description: Official and reported state budget figures covering oil and non-oil revenues, current and capital expenditure, and overall fiscal balance. Oil-revenue shortfalls relative to budget assumptions are a recurring feature under sanctions.
reports._notes: Core fiscal-flow node. Heavily oil-dependent.
reports._url_evidence: CBI 'Finance and Budget' statistics section; page states it contains tables of the government's general budget position and tax revenues, with monthly PDF releases.
reports._cadence_evidence: cbi.ir/category/2694.aspx (government general budget and tax revenue tables) lists twelve separate PDF files, one for each Persian-calendar month Farvardin through Esfand - a monthly release.

reports.title: Exchange-rate regime and parallel-market statistics
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Iran / parallel-market trackers
reports.description: Official and parallel-market exchange rates for the rial. Multiple rate systems and large gaps between official/preferential and free-market rates are a persistent feature under sanctions and high inflation.
reports._notes: Critical price and external-constraint node. Parallel-market premium is a key signal.
reports._url_evidence: Central Bank of Iran exchange-rate page showing rial rates against foreign currencies with the CBI weighted-average-rate methodology note.
reports._cadence_evidence: cbi.ir/exrates/rates_en.aspx presents a single dated rate table ('Exchange Rates 26/07/2024') and notes 'No rates are quoted on Iranian holidays, for which the previous day's rates will apply' - i.e. one quoted release per working day, roughly 250/yr.

reports.title: Industrial production and manufacturing statistics
reports.description: Official statistics on industrial establishments, manufacturing output, value added and related indicators. Industry operates under sanctions constraints on technology, finance and intermediate imports.
reports._notes: Core industrial statistical product.
reports._cadence_evidence: The node points at the amar.org.ir homepage, which says nothing about industrial/manufacturing survey periodicity and carries no release calendar or dated editions.

reports.title: Tehran province Gross Regional Domestic Product
reports.description: Official GRDP for Tehran province — by far the largest provincial economy, typically accounting for roughly one-fifth or more of national GDP. Dominant services, administration and industrial concentration.
reports._notes: Primary capital-region economic node. Strongest single provincial share.
reports._url_evidence: PARTIAL MATCH — retrieved the Statistical Centre of Iran's national-and-regional accounts page, which states in Persian that this section provides 'سهم هر استان در تولید ناخالص داخلی' (the share of each province in gross domestic product) and discusses the regional accounts (حساب‌های منطقه‌ای) being compiled before national-account revisions. It is the official SCI product family that carries provincial GRDP, but it is a national page, not a Tehran-specific page. The province-specific regional-accounts page (…/دادهها-و-اطلاعات-آماری/حساب-های-ملی-و-منطقه‌ای/حساب‌های-منطقه‌ای) was located via search but never returned a response across ~15 attempts.
reports._url_route: amar.org.ir short ASCII slug (/hesabmelli), retried across several up-windows

reports.title: Khuzestan province Gross Regional Domestic Product
reports.description: Official GRDP for Khuzestan — the principal oil-producing province and consistently one of the largest provincial economies after Tehran. Hydrocarbon activity dominates the local output structure.
reports._notes: Primary oil-province economic node.
_referenced_by: National Accounts and oil production statistics
reports._url_evidence: PARTIAL MATCH — same retrieved SCI national-and-regional accounts page, confirmed to state that it provides the share of each province in GDP. Not Khuzestan-specific; SCI's dedicated regional-accounts sub-page could not be retrieved despite repeated attempts.

reports.title: Banking system structure and credit statistics
reports.description: Statistics on the structure of the banking system, total assets, credit aggregates and related indicators. Operates under sanctions constraints on international correspondent relationships and domestic asset-quality pressures.
reports._notes: Core banking-system structural node.
reports._cadence_evidence: cbi.ir root was not retrievable on repeated attempts; the English landing page that answered says the Bank 'compiles and publishes a range' of monetary, financial and economic statistics but attaches no frequency to the banking/credit series.

reports.title: Agriculture production statistics
reports.description: Official volume and value statistics for major crops and livestock. Wheat is the dominant staple; other significant products include barley, pistachios, fruits and related commodities.
reports._notes: Core primary-sector production node.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved the Statistical Centre of Iran agricultural statistics portal. Page enumerates the SCI agricultural survey programme and its data sections: crop production and horticulture (stated as 71% of agricultural value added), livestock and poultry (milk, wool, poultry capacity), forestry, fisheries/aquaculture, greenhouse and mushroom production, general agricultural census series from 1339 onwards, and nomadic censuses (1366/1377/1387), each with tables, archive, publications and metadata.
reports._url_route: amar.org.ir short ASCII slug discovered via search, then retried until the host answered
reports._cadence_evidence: amar.org.ir/agricultural-statistics lists past survey and census years only (crop/horticulture surveys 1386, 1389, 1394, 1396, 1397; agricultural censuses 1367, 1372, 1382, 1393; mushroom censuses 1380, 1385, 1391, 1396). Intervals are irregular (5-11 years) and the page states no ongoing release frequency.

reports.title: Wheat production statistics
reports.description: Focused statistics on wheat area, yield and production. Wheat is the central food-security crop; production levels interact with imports, subsidies and climate variability.
reports._notes: Foundational food-security crop node.

reports.title: Education enrolment and literacy statistics
reports.description: Enrolment rates by level and literacy rates (including youth and gender-disaggregated figures). Youth literacy is high; overall adult literacy and higher-education attainment form the main human-capital stock indicators.
reports._notes: Core education access and literacy node.

reports.title: Petrochemical production and export statistics
reports.description: Production capacity, output and export statistics for the petrochemical sector. Petrochemicals are a major non-oil foreign-exchange earner and a significant share of non-oil exports and industrial value added.
reports._notes: Key non-oil industrial and export node that partially offsets pure crude dependence.
reports._url_evidence: PARTIAL MATCH — retrieved an official National Petrochemical Company (NPC) page carrying Iranian petrochemical capacity/output figures: ~3 million t of intermediate and final products in 1977, 14 million t/yr capacity by 1999, ~68 million t/yr by 2020, and a projected >133 million t/yr by 2025 from 55 ongoing projects. It is NPC's own page and does contain production-capacity statistics, but it is a narrative history page and carries no export statistics. No NPC statistics section could be reached (nipna.ir and nipc.ir Persian host both unreachable).
reports._url_route: alternate hostname — en.nipc.ir answered where nipc.ir / nipna.ir did not
reports._cadence_evidence: en.nipc.ir/History is a narrative company/industry history page with a placeholder 'Last Update date: Jan 1 1900'; it contains no statistical release schedule or dated editions.

reports.title: Non-oil export statistics
reports.description: Aggregate and commodity-structure statistics on non-oil exports. Petrochemicals, minerals, agricultural products and other manufactures form the main residual external-earnings base under oil sanctions.
reports._notes: External diversification densification of the trade cluster.

reports.title: Electricity generation and installed capacity statistics
reports.description: Installed generation capacity (thermal, combined-cycle, hydro, nuclear, renewables) and electricity production statistics. Capacity has surpassed 100 GW; gas and combined-cycle dominate; nuclear and renewables remain small shares.
reports._notes: Core power-system statistical product.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved the Statistical Centre of Iran water-and-electricity statistics page (دادهها و اطلاعات آماری › انرژی › آب و برق). Text confirms the electricity section covers 'generation, transmission, distribution and consumption of electricity (residential and industrial connections)' compiled annually since 1346, sourced from the Ministry of Energy (formerly Ministry of Water and Power). Note the publisher is SCI rather than the Ministry: Tavanir (tavanir.org.ir) still serves only an 'ORA-00257: archiver error' page and its statistics subdomain amar.tavanir.org.ir never answered.
reports._url_route: amar.org.ir Persian topic path, bare host, second attempt
reports._cadence_evidence: The SCI water-and-electricity data page states the Ministry of Energy 'هر ساله در قالب نشریات آماری تهیه و منتشر می‌کند' - prepares and publishes the electricity statistics annually in statistical publications.

reports.title: Mining and mineral production statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Industry, Mine and Trade
reports.description: Production statistics for metallic and non-metallic minerals. Iran ranks among the world’s leading producers for several commodities (e.g. strontium, direct-reduced iron, gypsum, iron ore).
reports._notes: Mining densification of the industrial cluster.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved the Statistical Centre of Iran mining statistics page (دادهها و اطلاعات آماری › صنعت و معدن › معدن). Text confirms it carries 'the status of existing mines in the country, production volume from active mines, value added of mineral production and investment in the sector', collected since 1333 with the first full mining census in 1342; sand/gravel mines sampled, other mines fully enumerated; ISIC Rev.4 classification; excludes petroleum, gas, radioactive materials and clay. IMIDRO (imidro.gov.ir) remained unreachable.
reports._url_route: amar.org.ir Persian topic path, bare host, second attempt

reports.title: Isfahan province Gross Regional Domestic Product
reports.description: Official GRDP for Isfahan — a major industrial and historic central province that ranks among the larger non-oil provincial economies.
reports._notes: Secondary industrial provincial node.
reports._url_evidence: PARTIAL MATCH — same retrieved SCI national-and-regional accounts page, confirmed to state that it provides the share of each province in GDP. Not Isfahan-specific; SCI's dedicated regional-accounts sub-page could not be retrieved.

reports.title: Fars province Gross Regional Domestic Product
reports.description: Official GRDP for Fars — a large southern province with mixed agriculture, services and industry that ranks in the upper tier of provincial economies.
reports._notes: Further provincial densification in the south-central belt.
reports._url_evidence: PARTIAL MATCH — same retrieved SCI national-and-regional accounts page, confirmed to state that it provides the share of each province in GDP. Not Fars-specific; SCI's dedicated regional-accounts sub-page could not be retrieved.

reports.title: Bushehr province Gross Regional Domestic Product
reports.description: Official GRDP for Bushehr — an important oil, gas and petrochemical province on the Persian Gulf that ranks among the larger provincial economies relative to its population.
reports._notes: Gulf oil/gas provincial densification.
reports._url_evidence: PARTIAL MATCH — same retrieved SCI national-and-regional accounts page, confirmed to state that it provides the share of each province in GDP. Not Bushehr-specific; SCI's dedicated regional-accounts sub-page could not be retrieved.

reports.title: International visitor arrivals and tourism statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Cultural Heritage, Tourism and Handicrafts
reports.description: Official statistics on foreign tourist arrivals and related tourism indicators. Arrivals have recovered into the multi-million range in recent Persian years despite sanctions and regional tensions.
reports._notes: Core tourism statistical product under constrained external conditions.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved the Statistical Centre of Iran tourism statistics page. Content confirms tourism data compilation began with the سازمان جلب سیاحان in 1342, first published in the 1345 Statistical Yearbook, drawn from customs, passport and other official records; visitor counts for museums and historical sites collected by the Cultural Heritage Organization to 1382 and then by the merged Cultural Heritage and Tourism Organization; pilgrim statistics limited to official pilgrimage channels. The page hosts the statistical tables, publications, metadata and archive for this series. mcth.ir itself never answered.
reports._url_route: amar.org.ir short ASCII slug (guessed by analogy with /agricultural-statistics and /building-permit-system, then verified by retrieval)

reports.title: Housing and construction permit statistics
reports.description: Statistics on building permits, residential units and construction activity. Housing investment and construction are sensitive to high inflation, credit conditions and urban demand.
reports._notes: Housing/construction densification of the investment cluster.
